summary: Maplebear Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a $500 million unsecured revolving credit facility with an uncommitted incremental facility and Morgan Stanley Senior Funding as administrative agent. The facility matures in April 2031, bears interest based on Term SOFR plus margins tied to total net leverage, and is guaranteed by material domestic subsidiaries. No amounts were drawn at closing. Proceeds are for working capital and general corporate purposes. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation; the filing does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, dividend, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or abrupt management change.
